#| label: library-import

# Load libraries

  "dplyr",
  "ggplot2",
  "janitor",
  "gtsummary",
  "stringr",
  "tidyr"
)
invisible(lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE))

```{r}
#| label: import-data

# Import data
tb_file <- "data/raw/tb_cytokine_synthetic_dataset.csv"
raw_data <- read.csv(tb_file, na = c("", "NA", "N/A", "Unknown", "Not tested"))

# Standardise column names
df <- raw_data |> 
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    tb_group = str_to_lower(str_trim(tb_group)),
    tb_group = str_replace_all(tb_group, "[ .]", "_"),
    tb_group = case_when(
      tb_group %in% c("control", "ctrl") ~ "Control",
      tb_group %in% c("active_tb", "active_tb", "atb") ~ "Active_TB",
      tb_group %in% c("ltbi", "l_t_b_i") ~ "LTBI",
      TRUE ~ tb_group
    )
  )
```
